# S2IsoMEr

## Overview

`S2IsoMEr` is an R package for metabolite enrichment analysis in imaging
MS. `S2IsoMEr` can be applied to spatial and single-cell metabolomics
datasets and addresses the challenge of metabolite identification
ambiguity. The key idea to handle molecular isomers and/or isobars is to
propagate the molecular ambiguity to the enrichment results as follows:
We apply iterative random sampling (bootstrapping), perform enrichment
analysis for each iteration, and report summarized results.

![](reference/figures/Main_figure.jpg)

## Installation

    install.packages("devtools")
    devtools::install_github("alexandrovteam/S2IsoMEr")

## Features

`S2IsoMEr` supports both overrepresentation analysis (ORA) and
metabolite set enrichment analysis (MSEA) for metabolite and lipid-based
backgrounds. Metabolite backgrounds are curated from [RAMP-DB
2.0](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/39/1/btac726/6827287),
encompassing biological pathways and metabolic classes, which are
further categorized into super, main, and sub-classes. The pathways from
RAMP-DB integrate multiple resources, including SMPDB, Reactome, KEGG,
and WikiPathways. For lipids, similar background types are provided,
with the addition of the [LION](http://lipidontology.com/) lipid
ontology. Except for the LION ontology, each term is mapped to either
molecule names or sum formulas, allowing enrichment analysis to be
performed with or without consideration of isomeric/isobaric ambiguity.

## Citation

Check out our preprint on bioRxiv: [Enrichment analysis for spatial and
single-cell metabolomics accounting for molecular
ambiguity](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.08.23.609355v1).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Load_background()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/Load_background.md)
  : Load enrichment background
- [`Run_bootstrap_MSEA()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/Run_bootstrap_MSEA.md)
  : Run Bootstrapped Metabolite Set Enrichment Analysis (MSEA)
- [`Run_bootstrap_ORA()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/Run_bootstrap_ORA.md)
  : Wrapper function for Bootstrap Over-Representation Analysis (ORA)
- [`Run_enrichment()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/Run_enrichment.md)
  : Run Metabolite/Lipids enrichment analysis for single cell
  metabolomics
- [`Run_simple_MSEA()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/Run_simple_MSEA.md)
  : Run Simple Metabolite Set Enrichment Analysis (MSEA)
- [`Run_simple_ORA()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/Run_simple_ORA.md)
  : Wrapper function for Simple Over-Representation Analysis (ORA)
- [`barplot_MSEA_boot()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/barplot_MSEA_boot.md)
  : Plot bootstrap enrichment analysis
- [`barplot_ORA_boot()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/barplot_ORA_boot.md)
  : Bar Plot for ORA Bootstrapped Results
- [`barplot_ORA_simple()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/barplot_ORA_simple.md)
  : Bar Plot for Simple ORA Results
- [`build_iso_bg()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/build_iso_bg.md)
  : Build Isomer/Isobar Background
- [`calc_LFC_scmat()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/calc_LFC_scmat.md)
  : Calculate Log Fold Change (LFC) from Single-Cell Metabolomics Matrix
- [`compare_metabo_distr()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/compare_metabo_distr.md)
  : Plot intensity distribution of metabolite across conditions
- [`decouple_ORA_wrapper()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/decouple_ORA_wrapper.md)
  : Run ORA Analysis with Optional Bootstrapping
- [`dotplot_ORA()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/dotplot_ORA.md)
  : Dot Plot for Over-Representation Analysis (ORA) Results
- [`get_TP_markers_per_Term()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/get_TP_markers_per_Term.md)
  : Get intersection between term and query for a Specific Term
- [`get_metabo_iso()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/get_metabo_iso.md)
  : Get Metabolite Isomers and Isobars
- [`initEnrichment()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/initEnrichment.md)
  : Generate S2IsoMEr enrichment object
- [`map_TP_markers_to_ions()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/map_TP_markers_to_ions.md)
  : Map True Positive Markers to Input Ions from single cell matrix.
- [`metabo_bootstrap()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/metabo_bootstrap.md)
  : Perform Bootstrap Sampling on Metabolite Annotations
- [`metap_sumlog_pvals()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/metap_sumlog_pvals.md)
  : Combine p-values Using the Sum of Logs Method
- [`passed_filters_per_term()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/passed_filters_per_term.md)
  : Report filters applied to bootstrap-based enrichment results
- [`plot_MSEA_Multi_cond()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/plot_MSEA_Multi_cond.md)
  : Plot Heatmap of MSEA Results Across Multiple Conditions
- [`rankScore()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/rankScore.md)
  : Rank metabolites for S2IsoMEr enrichment object
- [`ridge_bootstraps()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/ridge_bootstraps.md)
  : Ridge Plot of Bootstrap Enrichment Results for Terms of Interest
- [`setConditions()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/setConditions.md)
  : Set conditions for enrichment analysis
- [`simple_fgsea()`](https://alexandrovteam.github.io/S2IsoMEr/reference/simple_fgsea.md)
  : Run simple fGSEA enrichment
